subject: Scheduling: 60-90m Model Serving Immersion — Scalely next steps

Subject: Scheduling: 60-90m Model Serving Immersion — Scalely next steps

Hi Mike — thanks again for taking the time today. Good conversation and helpful signal on goals: reduce 99th pct latency for batch scoring, standardize KV cache across model variants, and establish a rollout/QA path for quantized weights.

Per our chat, the best next step is a focused 60–90 minute immersion with our ML infra and ops leads to:
- validate resource sizing assumptions
- walk through a short ops runbook (failover, fallback policies)
- confirm concrete action items / mutual action plan

Proposed times (all PT):
1) Tue Sep 15, 10:30–11:45 (75m)
2) Wed Sep 16, 13:00–14:15 (75m)
3) Thu Sep 17, 09:00–10:30 (90m)

I attached a draft agenda and a one-slide outline you shared during the call (immersion_agenda_v1.pdf, scalely_infra_outline.png). If none of those slots work, tell me a couple windows that do and we’ll align.

Attendees we suggest from our side: Neha (ops / runbooks), Laura (serving runtime), Karthik (solutions lead). If you want other engineers involved, please add them.

Next steps: can you confirm a preferred slot and the Scalely attendee list? Once confirmed we’ll send a calendar invite with readouts and a short pre-call checklist.

Thanks — looking forward.

—Dylan

Thanks — locked on Wed 13:00 PT. I sketched a handoff-oriented agenda to make the session actionable; propose we run 75 minutes with the following timebox:
- 0–8m: Introductions + success criteria (Dylan / Karthik)
- 8–20m: Scalely environment overview (Keya / Raj)
- 20–45m: Runtime walkthrough & demo (Laura) — focus on KV cache, latency profiles, and quantized path
- 45–60m: Ops runbook + failure modes (Neha) — include a quick checklist for rollback/fallback
- 60–75m: Open action review & mutual action plan (All)

Prep items:
- Scalely: two bullet-point environment constraints (cloud, VPC, retention limits) ahead of the call
- Scalely: expected steady-state qps and 95/99 latency targets (helps to size batching)
- Redwood: short pre-read (I’ll upload a one-pager) and Laura’s demo notebook (read-only link)

I will upload the pre-read and demo link to the shared agenda by EOD today. Attaching the runbook template as a stub (immersion_agenda_v1.pdf).
